method: Keep each existing broad scope. Reconcile the retained source/fixture evidence with the actual requirement and principle thresholds. Inspect additional pinned source only to answer explicit missing questions; do not report source assertions as executed product behavior.
role: Individual custodian of the existing backup, learning, note or research records

essential_records.restic: Existing backup profile: representative file bytes, hierarchy, permissions, links, timestamps, supported ACLs/xattrs and user-held recovery material.
essential_records.borgbackup: The same file-preservation goals, respecting the retained development commit rather than claiming Borg 1.x runtime behavior.
essential_records.kopia: Existing encrypted snapshot profile, including data and filesystem metadata, retention/maintenance and overwrite/delete boundaries.
essential_records.anki: Existing collection with notes/cards, decks/options, scheduling and media, including modern package formats; do not shrink this to the one-card legacy sample.
essential_records.joplin: Existing knowledge_notes profile, including nested notebooks, internal links, tags, resources and the stated encrypted/sync-conflict recovery scenario.
essential_records.zotero: Existing research_bibliographic profile including populated metadata/collections/relations, attachments/annotations and document-citation mappings; do not substitute an empty schema for a recovered library.

independent_checks: Reinspect retained Anki ZIP/SQLite/media and Zotero SQL schema with standard-library tools; verify retained hashes. Any newly constructed data is explicitly synthetic and cannot establish application-origin compatibility or a clean application restore.
decision_rule: Pass/Fail requires sufficient evidence for the stated scope. A guarded command or readable format alone does not establish complete E3/E5. Unknown is not Fail; positive Longevity/Transparency requires the corresponding established minimum. No automatic rating promotions.
installations: None authorized or needed; no target binary is downloaded, built or run.
